context.transcript:
Today I'll be presenting the work of Moritz Hoffman.
Moritz spent the last two years designing and renovating
the city hall building, saving a truly historic building —one
of the oldest in Madison. A project of this scale requires
a great deal of careful planning and attention to detail. And
Moritz spent a great deal of time on preparation. The whole
process was documented with photographs. Now, let's look
at some slides of the city hall before and after renovations.
context.transcript_translation: 今天我将介绍莫里茨·霍夫曼的工作。莫里茨花了过去两年时间设计并翻新市政厅大楼，挽救了一栋真正具有历史意义的建筑——它是麦迪逊最古老的建筑之一。如此规模的项目需要大量周密规划和对细节的关注，莫里茨也确实花了大量时间做准备。整个过程都用照片记录了下来。现在，让我们看一些展示市政厅翻新前后面貌的幻灯片。
